channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Thanasis Antetokounmpo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Thanasis Antetokounmpo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sofoklis Schortsanitis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Thanasis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
“I agree with that view. Regarding this topic, I want to say that, yes, I did experience racist behavior at times, but not as much as Giannis and Thanasis before they became well-known. I believe that people have indeed started to become more accepting of individuals with different skin colors or African roots.”

Sofoklis Schortsanitis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Thanasis Antetokounmpo, Jan 23, 2025. Source: Gazzetta.gr.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Thanasis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
In, ‘Giannis: The Marvelous Journey,' fans will realize how big of a role Thanasis plays in Giannis life and develop an appreciation for what can only be called perfect older brother.

“I'll say many times, if you could like create the perfect brother, Thanasis would probably be the person,”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Thanasis Antetokounmpo, Feb 22, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Georgios Kalaitzakis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Thanasis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
He joins Giannis and Thanasis Antetokounmpo and feels excited to begin practicing and playing with them.

“It’s a blessing to have two Greeks, Giannis and Thanasis, two amazing guys great players,”

Georgios Kalaitzakis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Thanasis Antetokounmpo, Aug 12, 2021. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Thanasis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Giannis wrote on Twitter.

“If this happens to Thanasis, who with pride and a permanent smile represents the Greek national team and Panathinaikos, I can't imagine what is happening to other colored people in Greece.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Thanasis Antetokounmpo, Nov 19, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Walt Perrin on Thanasis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Aaron Falk:Walt Perrin on Thanasis:

“Still a little bit raw offensively, but he's a much better, much better athlete than his brother.”

Walt Perrin on Thanasis Antetokounmpo, Jun 6, 2014. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.
